fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5.5% of Gross Room Revenues; may be reduced at franchisor discretion for multi-unit operators, market conditions, or LIGHT THE WAY incentive programs. Program Fee (marketing/brand fund) is 3% of Gross Room Revenues; may increase up to 0.5% per 12-month period, capped at 5.5%. Reservation Fee is 1% of Gross Room Revenues; may increase up to 0.5% per 12-month period, capped at 2%. IT Services Fee is currently $400/month plus $4.00 per Authorized Guest Room per month (may increase to $500/month plus $6.00/room). PMS Software Fee is $4.00 per Authorized Guest Room per month (may increase to $6.00/room). Online Subscription Fee (training/LMS) is $800-$1,200 annually. Portal Access Fee is $3-$5 per user per month. Direct Connect/Channel Fee is $1.50-$2.50 per reservation. PPP/Microsite: $299 setup + $499 annually; professional photos $699; content translation $199 setup + $99 annually. Sales360 Program Fee is $1,200/month (optional). Revenue Management for Hire: $499-$1,999/month depending on tier (optional). Booking Fees and Travel Agency Commissions: up to 20% of total room rate. CorporatePlus@6 Processing Fee: 4% of CorporatePlus@6 room revenue. National Sales RFP Tool Fee: $199 annually.
